## Evidence that would strengthen confidence

**Q: Does the maintenance log show whether a leak test was planned for the restart?** [FND-0001; EVD-0001]
- Why it matters: The level 1 finding on the untested restart rests on one work order (EVD-0001), a single document.
- Good evidence looks like: The maintenance log entry for the job, and the fitter's account of the restart
- Put to: Maintenance planner

*(learning: LR-01)*

**Q: Is there a record of a return-to-service checklist ever being drafted or withdrawn?** [FND-0002; EVD-0002]
- Why it matters: The level 3 finding on the missing checklist rests on the procedure index alone (EVD-0002), and no level 3 finding cites a witness.
- Good evidence looks like: Procedure change history, and an account from the supervisor who signs off restarts
- Put to: Maintenance supervisor

## What this scorecard cannot tell you

The scorecard counts the evidence links the export records [FND-0003]. It cannot judge how reliable a document or a statement is, and one strong source can outweigh several weak ones.
